dedupeText: 90s indie rock album aesthetic 90s alternative lo fi photography vertical typography grainy texture indie rock vertical white sidebar balancing the organic forms of the photograph high contrast relationship between the blue sidebar text and the green image overlay text warm yellow green wall tones contrasting with the cool blue typography tight cropping of the subject to emphasize texture and posture over identity combine a lo fi warm toned corner photograph with a 30 width white left sidebar containing vertical rounded sans typography and a high contrast color pop overlay in the bottom right

recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition featuring a grainy, warm-toned photograph of a person's legs in a corner, framed by a stark white vertical border on the left containing large-scale vertical text, and secondary text layered over the image at the bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical white sidebar balancing the organic forms of the photograph
High-contrast relationship between the blue sidebar text and the green image-overlay text
Warm yellow-green wall tones contrasting with the cool blue typography
Tight cropping of the subject to emphasize texture and posture over identity
coreInvariants: Vertical orientation for the primary title
White sidebar on the left third of the frame
Subtle drop shadow on overlay text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Legs and hands occupy the right two-thirds of the frame, cropped at the mid-thigh and feet.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The vertical white bar on the left acts as the primary structural anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large vertical text on the left, move down to the green text at the bottom right, then up the legs to the hands.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The white sidebar provides clean negative space against the busy, textured photo.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm ochre and muted yellow-green (background wall)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Medium blue (primary text) and vibrant grass green (secondary text)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Muted, low-saturation photo tones paired with highly saturated, medium-value typography.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Humanist and casual sans-serifs with rounded terminals
letterConstructionRules: Primary text is rotated 90 degrees counter-clockwise
Secondary text features tight kerning and slight overlapping
Rounded stroke endings to mimic marker or soft-ink printing
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a vertical, airy blue title and a horizontal, dense green subtitle.
graphicDevices: Vertical divider line (implied by the edge of the sidebar)

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the rounded, friendly but clean humanist skeleton of the primary text.
Provides the necessary density and weight for the bottom overlay text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a square photo of a person's legs from mid-thigh to feet, wearing white Mary Jane shoes, standing in a corner with yellow-green walls. Apply heavy film grain and a warm, slightly desaturated 90s analog filter. Leave the left 30% of the frame as a solid white vertical bar.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add blue vertical text in a rounded sans-serif font centered in the white bar. Add green text with a thin dark outline and soft drop shadow in the bottom right corner, staggered across two lines.

verificationChecks: Is the primary text rotated 90 degrees counter-clockwise?
Is there a distinct white sidebar on the left?
Does the photo have a visible grain and warm color cast?

adjustableVariables: Specific hue of the green and blue text
Subject of the photograph (while maintaining the corner composition)
mustRedesign: Avoid using the specific brand names or artist names from the original
Do not replicate the exact hand/leg scar details
Ensure the font is a modern equivalent rather than a direct rip of 90s proprietary faces

avoid: Default system fonts like Arial or Times New Roman

postGenerationChecks: Verify the text does not bleed into the image area from the sidebar
Check that the green text has a subtle drop shadow for legibility
Confirm the image aspect ratio is 1:1
Ensure the film grain is uniform across the photographic area
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a lo-fi, warm-toned corner photograph with a 30% width white left-sidebar containing vertical rounded-sans typography and a high-contrast color-pop overlay in the bottom right.
